statement: משנא הכתב הזא has the same construction as Deut 17:18 משנה התורה הזאת ('a copy of this Teaching', JPS 2023); the root ש-נ-ה can mean 'repeat (copy)' and 'change' (Fraade). The noun alone therefore means 'copy'; the three following nouns name content beyond a duplicate (explanation, measurements, particulars), i.e. copy + key.
